definitions.explanation: A fast pace of work, construction or change, usually to meet a deadline or an emergency: {工事|こうじ}が{急|きゅう}ピッチで{進|すす}む (construction is going ahead at full speed). ピッチ is English "pitch" in the sense of rate or tempo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急|きゅう}ピッチ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The work is moving ahead rapidly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{復旧|ふっきゅう}→復旧：07521_fukkyuu⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急|きゅう}ピッチ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Repair work is being carried out at full speed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{開幕|かいまく}→開幕：08174_kaimaku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{一か月|いっかげつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}り→切る：02693_kiru⟧、⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{急|きゅう}ピッチ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{進|すす}められている→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: With less than a month until the opening, preparations at the venue are being pushed ahead at a rapid pace.

notes:
Common in news reports about construction, recovery after disasters, and preparations for events. It can also describe a rise that happens quickly: {急|きゅう}ピッチ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}がり→値上がり：11538_neagari⟧ (prices rising fast).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急|きゅう}ピッチ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ / ⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧: to go / push ahead rapidly
- {急|きゅう}ピッチ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to work at full speed
- {急|きゅう}ピッチ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧: a rapid recovery

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧: rapid — a general word for fast change
- {突貫工事|とっかんこうじ}: rush construction work
